title: 12 Best Oslo's Specialty Coffee Scene
description: Explore Oslo's thriving specialty coffee scene. Discover the top 12 cafes, roasteries, and hidden gems for the best Nordic brews, espresso, and cozy fika experiences in 2026.

places.name: Tim Wendelboe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A filter coffee of their current single-origin offering to truly appreciate the nuanced flavors, or a perfectly crafted espresso.

places.name: Supreme Roastworks
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their V60 pour-over to experience the clarity of their roasts, or a creamy flat white.

places.name: Fuglen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic cappuccino, perfectly balanced, or one of their house-roasted filter coffees while soaking in the retro aesthetics.

places.name: Mocca Kaffebar & Brenneri
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their robust house blend espresso, perhaps in a latte, paired with a freshly baked pastry.

places.name: Java Espressobar & Kaffeforretning
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cortado or macchiato to experience the rich intensity of their espresso blend without too much milk.

places.name: Hendrix Ibsen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their seasonal filter coffees, often featuring unique beans, enjoyed with the soundtrack of a classic album.

places.name: My Ugly Baby
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic pour-over to cut through the sweetness of one of their innovative donuts, like the 'Pistachio Dream' or 'Brown Butter Glaze'.

places.name: Solberg & Hansen (Mathallen)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A rich and balanced espresso-based drink, like a latte, to enjoy amidst the culinary energy of Mathallen.

places.name: Stockfleths (Lille Grensen)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic filter coffee or a traditional Norwegian 'kaffe latte' with a 'skillingsbolle' (cinnamon bun).

places.name: Nord & Natt
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their rotating single-origin espressos or a meticulously crafted batch brew for a clean, flavorful experience.

places.name: Elden Kaffebar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic americano or a pour-over while enjoying the peaceful, unhurried atmosphere.

places.name: Liebling
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their strong filter coffee to accompany a slice of their famous cheesecake or a hearty German breakfast plate.
